mutationProbes.scope: Disposable common-O1 checkout, one mutation at a time; semantic assertion witnesses, all mutations restored before measurements and exact-source validation.

validation.scope: Exact proposed test change on original committed production source, without experimental O1 or unrelated role changes.
validation.logs: The author keeps full measurement, instrumentation, mutation and validation logs outside the repository.

limitations: The reported49.07% timing reduction is marginal O2 on a common isolated O1 expression, not shipped-source, identical-work or cumulative O1+O2 performance.
Named cases remain71 while construction renders decrease; callback and content assertions are strengthened.
Three local Linux samples establish no confidence interval, tail percentile, cross-platform or CI-wide improvement.
Original-scan full check is single correctness evidence, not a before/after suite timing comparison.
Temporary mutations probe selected faults rather than proving every possible regression is covered.

method.selection: All six planned instrumented runs, serial ordinary1-3 then contract1-3; no exclusions or repetitions.
method.scope: Current committed test-tooling changes plus only isolated O1 path expression and disposable profiling hooks. Not current committed production performance.
method.timer: Spawn to close of Node test runner; includes profiler overhead and primary process startup, excludes npm wrapper/install/lint/typecheck/verify.
method.cache: Fresh absolute NODE_COMPILE_CACHE directory per timed run; existing helper behavior retained; NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE unset. OS page cache not flushed.
method.preload: NODE_OPTIONS --import=file:<per-run-preload>; inherited through normal helper environments, without overriding hermetic environments or adding signal handlers.
hooks: Public child_process spawn, spawnSync and execFileSync dispatches/completions; command-category and first two source-stack frames only.
Completed global setTimeout callbacks, public fs cpSync/rmSync/mkdtempSync, normal process exit CPU rows.
AsyncLocalStorage spans around existing reference and stopAndResume function bodies; elapsed ReviewSandbox constructor.
instrumentationCoverage: Public child_process dispatch counts are not a complete OS process census; Node internal launches and shell descendants may bypass a parent hook.
Own process-start rows measure preload participation. Explicit NODE_OPTIONS overrides, failed starts or early kills can omit child rows.
Sync wrappers do not report a child PID in these logs, so their starts are separately unjoinable; absence of a PID join is not absence of a preload.
Own exit rows precede other exit handlers, native teardown/cache flush and OS exit. Parent close timing includes those stages and scheduling/event-loop delivery.
Missing end/CPU rows are censored; no signal handler was added to recover killed-process data.
JavaScript filesystem hooks do not measure native SQLite I/O/fsync or all file operations.
Completed timer durations overlap and include event-loop lag; readiness polls await real work, and watchdog callbacks do not automatically add latency.
File tags are inherited and selected from argv test paths; argument-like test paths are heuristic. Qualified in-process commands also require a fake-runtime caller and a test-file parent.

validation.scope: One separate uninstrumented exact-committed-source check/verify after all six profile runs; no isolated O1 or profiling source hooks. The report-only edits do not alter its code inputs.
validation.logs: The author keeps full validation logs outside the repository.

limitations: Instrumented post-O1 observations, not a before/after speedup or cumulative improvement figure.
Three local Linux samples establish no confidence interval, tail percentile, cross-platform or hosted-CI performance.
Cumulative process/Git/timer/setup intervals overlap and must not be added to suite elapsed time or treated as removable wall time.
Per-child intersections may count the same parent Git interval for several children and do not partition causality.
All profiling source hooks are disposable; no production, test, policy, cache or CI implementation changes are included.
The author keeps complete raw profile/validation logs outside the repository.

boundedPathScanIntegration.scope: Bounded path scanning and two public-API regressions integrated after the independent CI, incremental-typecheck, duplicate-scenario and boundary-padding changes. Source, regressions, proposal and generated engine outputs belong to one change; unrelated role edits are excluded.
boundedPathScanIntegration.historicalEvidence: The existing controlledOrdinarySuite, pairedPathScan and remainingBottleneckProfile records remain unchanged. No new performance comparison or profile is collected here; prior profile counts exclude the two additional regressions.
